description: This file contains Drupal hook implementations for theme-related functionalities, including theme suggestions, preprocessing, and admin page rendering.

classes.name: SystemThemeHooks
classes.description: Contains hook implementations for theme suggestions and preprocessing in Drupal.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme suggestions and variables for various Drupal templates.

methods.name: preprocessEntityAddList
methods.description: Prepares variables for the entity add list template, adding descriptions to bundles.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsHtml
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions for HTML pages based on current path.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsPage
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions for page templates, including error pages based on HTTP status.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsMaintenancePage
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions for maintenance pages, especially when database is offline.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsRegion
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions for region templates based on region name.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsField
methods.description: Provides theme suggestions for field templates based on field type, name, entity type, and bundle.

methods.name: preprocessBlock
methods.description: Preprocesses block variables, especially for the system branding block.

methods.name: preprocessToolbar
methods.description: Preprocesses toolbar variables, handling theme overrides and cache tags.
